scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mohandishub/shared && npm run build -w @mohandishub/api && npm run build -w @mohandishub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mohandishub/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mohandishub/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mohandishub/api && npm run typecheck -w @mohandishub/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @mohandishub/api && npm run lint -w @mohandishub/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mohandishub/shared && npm run test -w @mohandishub/shared && npm run test -w @mohandishub/api && npm run test -w @mohandishub/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @mohandishub/api && npm run test:coverage -w @mohandishub/web
